{{RV|type=command

|game1= tkoh
|version1= 1.01

|game2= arma3
|version2= 0.50

|gr1= Environment

|descr= Set the density of ambient cars in a rectangle (in cars per kilometer). {{Feature|arma3|This command does nothing in {{arma3}}.}}

|s1= [[setTrafficDensity]] [density, xMin, xMax, zMin, zMax]

|p1= density: [[Number]] - density (in cars per kilometer)
|p2= xMin: [[Number]] - western border of the affected rectangle
|p3= xMax: [[Number]] - eastern border of the affected rectangle
|p4= zMin: [[Number]] - southern border of the affected rectangle
|p5= zMax: [[Number]] - northern border of the affected rectangle

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>setTrafficDensity [40, 31000, 32000, 30000, 32000];</sqf>

|seealso= [[enableTraffic]] [[setTrafficDistance]] [[setTrafficGap]] [[setTrafficSpeed]]
